name: Middle Peak via South Face - South Chimney

access.fees: Standard Okanogan-Wenatchee NF trailhead/parking fee policies apply in addition to the wilderness permit.
access.notes: Northwest Forest Pass required ($5/day or $30/annual). Free wilderness permit available (self-issue at trailhead). Day use accessible May 15 - October 31 (peak season July-September). Closed by the Three Queens Fire closure: Order 06-17-03-2026-44, effective September 18 through October 31, 2026 unless rescinded sooner, closes the Mineral Creek Trailhead and the Mineral Creek Trail. Contact Cle Elum Ranger District: (509) 852-1100 for current conditions.
access.permit: Self-issue, free wilderness permit at the trailhead.
access.landManager: Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest, Cle Elum Ranger District (Alpine Lakes Wilderness)
access.passRequired: Northwest Forest Pass or America the Beautiful pass typically required for trailhead parking.

overnight_permit.what: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit
overnight_permit.where: Fill one out at the trailhead kiosk and carry your copy.

approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: North from Cle Elum via Highway 903 (17 miles past Lake Cle Elum), then left on Cooper Lake Road (FR-4600) approximately 10 miles, over Cooper Pass and down to the trailhead at the road's end in the valley bottom
